ios.desc:
WHAT DOES YOUR MUSIC LOOK LIKE?

Reimagen AI is the first "Synesthesia Engine" designed to turn your favorite songs into high-fidelity AI artwork. By pulling metadata directly from Spotify and YouTube Music, Reimagen AI creates a visual soul for every track in your library.

Experience the dramatic, romantic brushstrokes of legendary master Raden Saleh. From the rhythm of your favorite hits to the heritage of fine art—see your playlist reimagined.

--- HOW IT WORKS ---

SYNC YOUR SOUND Search for any track or artist from Spotify or YouTube Music directly in the app.

GENERATE WITH AI Our engine analyzes the song title and mood to seed a custom Stable Diffusion prompt automatically.

THE RADEN SALEH STYLE Watch as your track is transformed into a 19th-century masterpiece, featuring the iconic lighting and epic scale of Raden Saleh’s legendary portfolio.

COLLECT & SHARE Export your "Song Art" in high resolution. Perfect for unique album covers, social media stories, or custom wallpapers.

--- FEATURES ---

• Instant Music-to-Art: No complex prompting required—just pick a song. • Raden Saleh Model: Exclusive Stable Diffusion tuning for authentic Indonesian Romanticism styles. • High-Resolution Upscaling: Enhance your creations for crisp, professional-grade visuals. • Creative Control: Add your own "Style Seeds" to the music title for a personalized touch.

--- INTRODUCING SEMITONES ---

Unlock the future of AI creativity with Semitones, our in-app currency. • [COMING SOON] New Styles: Unlock Cyberpunk, Anime, and Surrealist models. • [COMING SOON] Pro Editing: Use Semitones for advanced in-painting and 4K upscaling.

Stop just listening to your music. Start seeing it.

Download Reimagen AI today and paint your playlist.
